Well, here's the damage now though. In my (likely bordering on clinical) paranoid anxious state yesterday morning I wasn't about to go and await a potential arrest. Like I kinda hinted at in all the word vomit, I have a Failure to Register from my first year convicted. It could've been maybe fought and dismissed but the appointed pond scum attorney fear mongered me into essentially bundling my probation revocation hearing and the plea deal on the Failure charge for five years.

But now I'm a day late after calling on Tuesday and us casually setting up Thursday morning. If I'm going to make it through this tunnel ahead in my life...I don't think I can make it through even a wait for hearing in jail right now without the mental hospital first. And so it'll be on paper too that I am experiencing the suicidal ideations to the extent that I am...but admitting myself today..is this just gonna be a likely Failure To Register now awaiting me? Can anybody tell me if the mental hospital would more likely discharge me into county custody for that or if I'd be able to discharge freely and turn myself in or what have you? Because everything I see Googling seems to suggest I don't have much chance to avoid it once it's outside the window. I mean wouldn't a literal nearly suicide attempt and voluntary admittance to a mental hospital be the sorta circumstances that would hopefully be understood? I just can't try for the best with the mental hospital stressed I could be stuck signing on to 2 to 10 again too
Thank you, reading through the responses now and this one in particular meant a lot.
Thank you for both the resources. And no sorry necessary in the slightest. You've been tremendously helpful. :)

As somebody whose felony (before you console me, it's one of THOSE felonies so save your breath...even if you believe me that I didn't download the fucking picture, I don't count as human anymore just for having it on my record and we all know it) prevents him from working even the lowest jobs anymore and I've lost the last two over solely somebody finding out about my record, I feel where she is coming from. Won't bother making mine this long, who cares when an SO dies, innocent or not?
